caption: The drawing depicts a white ceramic cup with a decorative blue pattern. The cup has a wavy, scalloped rim that is outlined with blue, and a single ornate handle on the right side. Around the upper portion of the cup, there is a central blue motif framed within a decorative oval border; inside this border are depictions of two deer, a tree, and some ground foliage, all rendered in blue. The lower portion of the cup is adorned with vertical, swirling embossed patterns that have a slight blue-gray shading, giving the cup a textured appearance. The overall background of the drawing is off-white, and the drawing is bordered by a simple rectangular line. In the lower-left corner, the words "ACTUAL SIZE" are written, and in the lower-right corner, there is a handwritten signature reading "T. M. Holloway."
title: Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
